items.quote: The metallographic samples were examined using optical microscopy (OM) and a JEOL JSM 6360LV scanning electron microscope (SEM) equipped with energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) in back scattered electron (BSE) imaging mode.
The DTA measurements were performed between room temperature and 900 °C with heating and cooling rates of 5 K/min in a flowing argon atmosphere.

items.label: Fifteen ternary Cu-Si-Zn alloys
items.quote: Fifteen ternary Cu-Si-Zn alloys, the nominal compositions of which are listed in Table 4 and shown in Fig. 2, were prepared as described below.

items.label: alloy 10
items.quote: In order to determine the temperature of the invariant reaction L = γ + η + (Si), alloy 10 in the γ + η + (Si) three-phase region was subjected to differential thermal analysis (DTA) (DSC 404C, Netzsch, Germany) measurements in an Al2 O3 crucible.
All the samples were separately re-sealed in evacuated quartz tubes and annealed at 600 °C for 960 h in an L4515-type diffusion furnace, and then quenched in cold water.
